newsitem.title: UK: Village to run giant 30-screen UK cinema.
newsitem.headline: Village to run giant 30-screen UK cinema.

text.p: Australian cinema operator Village Roadshow Ltd has agreed to run a planned 30-screen cinema, due to be the largest in Europe, developers of the 50 million stg Star Site near the English city of Birmingham said on Monday.
Richardson Developments, a private company, said in a statement it expected the 30-screen multiplex to draw up to three million customers a year when it opens in 1999.

It added that it was "highly likely" that the 6,000-plus seat complex would be part of the Warner Village network run by a European joint venture of Village Roadshow and Time Warner Inc unit Warner Bros.

The cinema will anchor the 350,000 square foot leisure and retail scheme, in which locally-based construction company Tarmac Plc is also a partner. It is located near the M6 motorway and the famously-complex Spaghetti Junction.

"About 3.4 million people live within a 40 minute drive of the Star Site, and with researchers expecting cinema audiences to accelerate over the next four years by nearly 40 percent, Village Roadshow anticipate the development will be one of the industry's major success stories," Richardson said.
